about_the_game:
Deep in the shadows, Tulah, the Spider Queen has been waiting. This brand-new hero brings a new deck-building strategy with her ability to summon spiderlings — tiny allies that weave their way into your hand, reshaping combat in new and unexpected ways.

This Hero Pack Includes:

  • New Hero: Tulah, the Spider Queen – A fresh playstyle featuring spiderlings and deck-swarming mechanics.

  • Exclusive Pet: The Cocoon – A mysterious pet that evolves based on your talent choices.

  • 3 Thematic Skins – Style Tulah in different, chilling outfits.

  • 3 Unique Cardbacks – Spin a web of style with new deck designs.

  • 5 New Emotes – Share your eight-legged excitement.

  • Expanded Event Interactions – New, custom dialogue for Tulah as she weaves her way through world events.
